# Release Checklist

- [ ] Playwright mobile viewport passed
- [ ] Core E2E flow passed: add, edit, delete, next status
- [ ] Customer order and image-selection E2E passed
- [ ] Local storage persists refresh
- [ ] Firebase remains optional and safe
- [ ] `npm run security` passed with no high or critical vulnerabilities
- [ ] Firebase CDN and npm versions match
- [ ] CodeQL job is configured and passed
- [ ] Dependabot monitors npm and GitHub Actions
- [ ] Deploy workflow present and valid
- [ ] Deploy waits for E2E and CodeQL jobs
- [ ] README has start + deploy steps
